about: Tool action reroll_voices (GNX DEBUG > NEW VOICES): every captive (prison, cage, cells) gets a new moan voice from the loaded banks. And a captive whose bank is gone (its mod removed) gets a new voice when checked instead of staying silent.
why_no_boot_suite: VOICE CLASS (harness_voice) ships no sprite files, so the boot suite's class sprite checks fail by design

steps.name: gnx_scn_voice_count
steps.why: every captive has a bank that is not loaded

steps.name: gnx_scn_voice_all_real
steps.why: every captive has a loaded bank now

steps.name: gnx_scn_voice_checked_real
steps.why: a voice of a removed mod is replaced when checked (it stayed, and the captive was silent)
